content: Occupational therapy services 2-3 times per week for 45-minute sessions to address sensory integration and fine motor development with a focus on age-appropriate play activities.
Physical therapy services once a week for 45-minute sessions to enhance gross motor skills, including crawling and standing.
Consideration of speech therapy evaluation to assess and support emerging communication skills, particularly focusing on babbling and oral motor development.
Engagement in early intervention services to provide a multidisciplinary approach for developmental support across all domains.
Implementation of a home program encouraging activities such as stacking blocks, playing with musical toys, and rolling a ball to stimulate fine motor skills and cognitive engagement.
Environmental modifications to include a safe, enriched play area with age-appropriate toys that promote exploration and curiosity.
Caregiver training sessions bi-monthly to educate on strategies to incorporate developmental activities into daily routines, emphasizing sensory-rich playtime.
Provision of adaptive equipment such as a supportive highchair or floor seat to enhance participation and engagement in mealtime activities.
Recommendations for daycare accommodations that support sensory-friendly environments, including quieter nap areas and diversified tactile experiences.
Follow-up assessments every 3 months to monitor Sabrina's progress and adjust therapeutic interventions as necessary.
